lesson: This was the third recent first-scorer miss to an aerial defender. For matches with meaningful corner or free-kick routes, reserve one top-five slot for the likeliest centre-back rather than using all five on attackers.
The live federal docket and named DOJ representation were direct evidence and justified a highly concentrated forecast.
Contemporaneous reports naming Qatar's mediation role and the established negotiating channel supported near-certainty.
The slate was too concentrated on headline forwards and omitted a credible attacking midfielder. First-scorer forecasts should retain a slot for a high-minute midfield runner or set-piece threat.
For a weakly observable biographical event, a broad candidate slate successfully captured the answer; avoid false concentration when there is no direct public evidence.
